business_question: Are entire homes priced differently from other room types?
null_hypothesis: Mean log price is equal for entire homes and other room types.
alternative_hypothesis: Mean log price differs between entire homes and other room types.
exclusion_rules: Rows require positive listing price and room type.
test_rationale: Welch test is used because group variances may differ.
assumption_diagnostics: entire home/apt N=4771, other room types N=1606; Shapiro p-values 4.632e-34, 2.802e-13; Levene p-value 0.02278.
confidence_interval_95: log-price mean difference entire home/apt minus other room types: [0.6347, 0.6924]
plain_english_interpretation: entire home/apt listings have higher mean log price than other room types listings; this is an association, not a causal effect.

business_question: Is host-set availability associated with listing price?
null_hypothesis: There is no monotonic association between availability rate and log price.
alternative_hypothesis: There is a monotonic association between availability rate and log price.
exclusion_rules: Rows require positive listing price and non-missing availability_rate.
test_rationale: Robust rank-based test for monotonic association.
plain_english_interpretation: availability_rate has a negative rank association with log price; this is not causal.
limitation_or_sensitivity: Sensitivity is the rank-based method itself; it does not assume linearity.
